One small project first先從小專案開始

One project, from problem to decision.同一個專案，從問題走到決策。

Try member sign-in and password reset. Keep the project selected as you move from its status to a sourced discussion and a reviewable update.先試會員登入與忘記密碼的小專案。從總覽找到問題、帶入討論，到審閱更新，都保留同一份專案脈絡。

  1. 01

    Understand the state看懂狀況

    Open Overview for the goal, accepted requirements, blockers and pending decisions. Read saved reports separately.在專案總覽看目標、已驗收需求、阻礙與待決事項；需要回顧時再切換已存報告。

  2. 02

    Find the problem找到問題

    Open a record in Requirements, Issues & changes or Schedule and inspect its original evidence.從需求、問題與變更或時程開啟紀錄，查看原始證據與下一步。

  3. 03

    Discuss with PM與 PM 討論

    Use the record's Discuss action. Its context and title follow you into Discussions; save a note and ask the PM.按紀錄上的討論入口，來源與標題會一起帶入；寫下想法，再請 PM 提案。

  4. 04

    Review and adopt審閱並採用

    Check the proposed wording, retained requirements and open questions. An authorized owner explicitly adopts the reviewed update.核對建議文字、保留需求與未決問題，再由有權限的負責人明確採用。

Adoption needs the PM-owned Git worktree and owner authority. It does not start work or accept a requirement. Passing tests, merging and deployment retain their own evidence.採用需要 PM 自有 Git 工作區及工作空間擁有者權限。採用不會直接開工或完成需求驗收；測試、合併與部署各自保留證據。

Clear responsibilities清楚的分工

One central history. Work on the chosen host.同一份中央歷史，工作留在選定主機。

Project management builds on Connector, BAT and Fleet. Web and Tauri share the same product surface.專案管理建立在 Connector、BAT 與 Fleet 之上；Web 和 Tauri 使用同一份產品介面。

Keep the same central沿用同一個中央

Desktop prepares one private local central. Explicitly join an existing central when needed; connection failure never replaces its database.桌面準備一套私人本機中央，需要時明確加入既有中央；連線失敗不會另造資料庫。

Know where PM runs知道 PM 在哪裡執行

Bounded PM analysis runs on an eligible Linux central or BAT host. A Windows/Mac client can use that route; installing its desktop app does not add a native coding adapter.有界 PM 分析在合格 Linux 中央或 BAT 主機執行。Windows／Mac client 可使用該路徑，桌面安裝本身不會增加一般原生 coding adapter。

Start with a reviewed build從核對過的版本開始

Install, connect, try a small project.安裝、連線，先試一個小專案。

Desktop packages include Python and prepare the local central. Account trust and work destinations remain explicit choices.桌面包包含 Python 並準備本機中央；帳號信任與工作目的地仍由你明確選擇。

  1. Match the package核對套件

    Choose a successful main platform build and match the artifact to its source commit and validation records.選成功的 main 平台建置，核對 artifact 的來源 commit 與驗證紀錄。

  2. Connect your environment連接環境

    Get ready to work opens 1. Connect BAT. Paste BAT’s connection URL, check Host ID, then Verify and save host. After success, choose View sessions. Repository binding and verification commands stay collapsed until needed.準備開始工作會展開「1. 連線至 BAT」。貼上 BAT 連線網址、核對主機代號，再按「驗證並儲存主機」。成功後按「查看工作階段」；儲存庫與驗證命令需要時再展開。

  3. Follow one result追完一份成果

    Start a small PM scope, inspect its original evidence and record what still needs a decision.從小範圍 PM 工作開始，檢視原始證據，記錄仍需決定的事項。

Advanced users can explicitly join an existing central. GitHub Actions artifacts can expire and may require sign-in. These packages are development validation builds, not a stable signed update channel. Ownership and recovery歸屬與恢復

Keep control and history intact.保留控制邊界，也保留歷史。

Your workspace stays yours人的工作區保持原樣

Human sessions and worktrees remain read-only through Connector. Reading a source does not grant control of it.Connector 對人工 session 與 worktree 保持唯讀；能讀來源，不代表能控制來源。

Each action has authority每個動作都有權限依據

The current principal, host policy, source access and original resource identity are checked before effects.效果執行前核對目前身分、主機政策、來源存取及原資源身分。

A lost reply is still traceable遺失回覆仍可追查

Keep the original operation and key while a result is uncertain. Query its evidence instead of dispatching another copy.結果未知時保留原 operation 與 key；查證據，避免再派一份工作。

Host isolation still matters主機隔離仍有自己的責任

Connector policy works with host accounts and confinement. It is not an operating-system sandbox.Connector 政策與主機帳號、隔離機制一起運作，本身不是作業系統 sandbox。

Practical questions使用前的問題

Know what to expect.先了解可以期待什麼。

Does BAT have to run on this computer?BAT 一定要在這台電腦執行嗎？

No. The Dashboard can connect to a configured central and BAT host. Coding work stays on the selected host; the browser's operating system does not determine runtime support.不必。Dashboard 可連已配置的中央與 BAT 主機；開發工作留在選定主機，瀏覽器的作業系統不決定 runtime 支援。

Will PM act on everything I say?跟 PM 說的每句話都會直接執行嗎？

Discussion creates records and proposals. Adoption, dispatch and maintenance policy are explicit product actions with their own authority and fixed scope.討論形成紀錄與提案；採用、派工及維護政策是明確的產品操作，各有權限與固定範圍。

Does it scan every CLI's tokens?已經會掃每個 CLI 的 token 嗎？

Local Codex and Claude collectors are implemented. Agents shows sourced observations, daily buckets where available and reported quota windows. Remote collection and delivery-efficiency attribution remain planned; token traffic is not a subscription quota or bill.已有 Codex 與 Claude 本機 collector。Agent 資源顯示有來源的觀測、可用的每日桶及回報配額窗；遠端收集與交付效率歸因仍待做，token 流量也不能直接當成訂閱配額或帳單。

Will optimization change my model automatically?優化會自動換掉我的模型嗎？

No usage-driven model policy is active. Future recommendations need measured delivery quality; adopted policy should apply to new owned work while preserving existing and human sessions.尚未啟用依用量自動改模型的政策。未來建議需要交付品質的實測，採用後應作用於新的自有工作，保留既有及人工 session。

Can I leave it unattended all day?可以整天放著無人值守嗎？

Only within verified capabilities and adopted bounds. Controlled fixtures do not establish readiness of your accounts, hosts or deployment targets; real-environment acceptance remains with the owner.須在已驗證能力及採用界線內使用；受控 fixture 不代表你的帳號、主機或部署目標已就緒，實際環境驗收仍由使用者處理。

Is this an official BAT product?這是 BAT 官方產品嗎？

It is an unofficial MIT-licensed companion. BAT is by TonyQ and contributors. Project Hub informs selected interaction patterns without a runtime or importer dependency.這是 MIT 授權的非官方 companion。BAT 由 TonyQ 與貢獻者開發；部分互動參考 Project Hub，沒有 runtime 或 importer 依賴。

Better Agent Dashboard

Project management on bat-agent-connector. An unofficial BAT companion.以 bat-agent-connector 為中央的專案管理工具，BAT 的非官方 companion。
